summary: Clean the teeth of all these people!
description:
In Teeth Runner, the simple goal is to brush the teeth of people : humans, zombies, vampires, muchachos … They all require different ingredients, so be careful while you brush their teeth, to pick up the right toothpaste !

First, brush the teeth of the characters along the path, if you do it well enough, you might even unlock the rainbow toothpaste and be able to brush the teeth of everyone all at once ! At the end, throw your ball of tooth paste as far as possible and clean gold teeth, arm teeth, rooster teeth … Be careful of obstacles like people with their tongue out; this game isn’t called lick runner, so you’ll have to avoid them in your run !

Go into the shop and find a wide variety of toothbrushes that you can buy. There’s even stranger and more awesome objects, super original like a toilet brush ! You can also buy different cannons to shoot your toothpaste from.
Enjoy the variety of environments as you brush the teeth of everyone around the world. Remember, you should brush your teeth everyday, and now you’ll be able to brush the teeth of others as well, making it even more fun ! Go ahead and show us your teeth-wielding skills !
